pages.title: PawPal | Book a trusted dog walker near you
pages.description: Book vetted dog walkers in your neighbourhood in two taps. Live GPS map of every walk.
pages.text: Walks your dog will love. Book a walker in your neighbourhood in two taps, from 30-minute strolls to hour-long adventures. Every walker passes an ID check and a meet-and-greet before their first walk. Watch the walk live on a GPS map and get a photo when your dog is home. The app is free to download and you pay per walk. PawPal Plus is $4.99 a month and removes booking fees. Available in London, Manchester and Bristol.
